Class GyroIO.GyroIOInputs

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.gyro.GyroIO.GyroIOInputs
Enclosing interface:

public static class GyroIO.GyroIOInputs extends Object
Plain data holder for one cycle's worth of gyro readings, populated by GyroIO.update().
